diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~65% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (10 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.212), which favours a robust combination.
